title: བསྟན་འགྱུར། སྡེ་དགེ། དབུ་མ། ཁི (Derge Tengyur, vol. 111)
shelf_note: Canonical Madhyamaka treatise in the Derge Tengyur (vol. 111, dBu ma, Khi).

ocr_errors.problem: interpolated extra syllable པ་ into the phrase

tr_errors_B.english: just as one openly treats others with respect
tr_errors_B.problem: translated བརྙས་ (contempt/disparagement) as respect, reversing the meaning

pages.prefer_reason: Translation A correctly translates བརྙས་ as contempt rather than reversing its meaning to respect as B does.

book_verdict: A well-preserved Derge Tengyur woodblock folio from the Madhyamaka section concerning the purification of the bodhisattva's body and resources.
